summary: [standards] No test covers the multi-id disk-error path, and its human summary is false on a policy failure. I exercised the path by hand. With three ids and the second brief read-only, the call exits 1 with written/failed/skipped, a stays approved, and a rerun reports a unchanged; this matches F1. With .canon/policy.approval.json unwritable, the human output still prints `2 change(s); policy approval recorded too` before POLICY_APPROVAL_FAILED. Fix: add a test with a read-only brief (and one with an unwritable policy approval), and print the policy clause only when no failure occurred.
